post.title: Nail salons keep about 22 cents of every dollar
post.ig:
Nail salons keep about 22 cents of every dollar.

Census data for salons with employees, 2022: $12.9B in revenue, $10.1B in expenses, before income taxes (latest in the Census Service Annual Survey).
Revenue dipped to $6.4B in 2020, then reached $12.9B in 2022.
A single salon can run tighter. Hypothetical $30 manicure: $15 to the tech at a 50% commission (a common rule of thumb), $3 supplies and $8 rent and bills (assumed) leave $4, about 13%.
Median manicurist pay was $17.19 an hour in May 2025 (BLS).

Sources: US Census Bureau Service Annual Survey (via FRED), BLS OEWS May 2025, Zenoti.
